title: Fable independent validation cases for Accounting Agent OS 0.1.0
notice: Every name, amount, date, account, vendor and policy is fictional and reviewer-authored. None of it is Bird Bowl data or approved accounting policy. Expected blocker codes for behaviour that does not exist yet are proposed names.
independence: Cases use their own profile, period (February 2027), accounts, vendors and sources. They do not mutate or reuse teaching.json or its expected answers.

test_stages.executable_now: Runs against the current modules. Expected outcome equals current behaviour; verified by executing run_fable_validation_cases.py against release 0.1.0.
test_stages.executable_now_fails_until_fix: Runs against the current modules and currently produces current_behavior_observed. expected_* states the required outcome after the linked finding is fixed.
test_stages.future_module_specification: Module is deferred. current_expected_behavior is the required result today (refused, no artifact); expected_* is the accounting outcome the future module must produce.

steps: human-a (preparer) registers the profile and intakes journal VJ-01 with its support

cases.expected_outcome: The approval is refused (403): the reviewer authored the evidence and the policy under review.
cases.rationale: Independence must cover everyone who shaped the artifact (source supplier, profile registrant, enqueuer, mandate issuer), not only the actor who pressed run.

steps: preparer intakes a revised memo for VJ-01
reviewer approves using the earlier hash
re-prepare; reviewer approves the new artifact

cases.expected_outcome: Approval with the earlier hash is refused (409). The re-prepared artifact is approvable. The earlier artifact keeps zero decisions.
cases.rationale: An approval binds one exact version. A decision captured before a source revision must never attach to the revised content.

steps: issue a daily mandate; deliver two occurrences on unchanged inputs; drain each
reviewer approves VJ-01 from occurrence 1 and rejects VJ-01 from occurrence 2

cases.expected_outcome: Exactly one artifact governs VJ-01 for a given input version. Either the second occurrence reuses the governing artifact, or earlier ones are superseded and refuse new decisions.
cases.rationale: Three 'current' copies of one journal with pending, approve and reject outcomes leave the export without a single answer for the item.

cases.expected_outcome: The approved artifact remains reported as approved and frozen for the locked period. New or changed entries dated in that period are held with PERIOD_LOCKED.
cases.rationale: A lock exists to protect reviewed work. Today the lock is a profile edit, which invalidates every approval in the client.

steps: new evidence arrives before the worker claims the run
worker drains (run is held as stale)
deliver the same occurrence again; worker drains

cases.expected_outcome: The occurrence is re-dispatched against current inputs (new attempt linked to the same occurrence) and produces artifacts. Still exactly one completed preparation per occurrence.
cases.rationale: Evidence arriving is the normal trigger for recurring work. A held run that permanently consumes its occurrence means the scheduled work silently never happens.

steps: issue mandate M1 for journal_preparation and M2 for card_preparation
register a profile version that removes journal_preparation from procedures

cases.expected_outcome: M2's occurrence is dispatched. M1 is recorded as held/invalid with a visible exception. The tick does not raise.
cases.rationale: One mandate that no longer fits the client must not stop every other recurring workflow or freeze the clock.

current_behavior_observed.tick: raises 403; zero runs created for any mandate

steps: attempt to deliver an earlier time

cases.expected_outcome: Both deliveries return the same run id. The earlier time is refused (409). One run exists for the occurrence.
cases.rationale: At-least-once event delivery must resolve to one business operation; time cannot run backwards to mint extra occurrences.
